children: Avis Budget Group strengthened its fleet financing platform as subsidiary ABRCF issued $650 million of five-year asset-backed securities secured by U.S. rental vehicles and related assets. The Series 2026-5 transaction includes Class A-D notes and a $35.75 million retained Class R tranche to meet U.S. risk retention. Concurrently, the company executed a series of technical amendments across its base indenture, leases, loan agreements and administration agreement to align documentation with the new issuance and streamline operations. The actions support liquidity and ongoing fleet investment.
